text: We recommend that you invest the £14,500 you have available as a lump‑sum into a Stocks & Shares ISA (wrapper “ss_isa”) holding the Aldercroft Balanced Growth Fund.

This recommendation is made before any transaction is carried out and will be set out in writing for you to review and confirm [FF:C001:recommendation_context.recommended_wrapper][FF:C001:recommendation_context.investable_amount_gbp][FF:C001:recommendation_context.contribution_type]
- **Primary objective:** build a fund for a career break [FF:C001:objectives.primary_objective]
- **Target amount:** £142,000 [FF:C001:objectives.target_amount_gbp]

- **Investment horizon:** you indicated “around 5 years” in the fact‑find [FF:C001:objectives.horizon_text][FF:C001:objectives.horizon_years] (you later mentioned “about 10 years” in the meeting) [TR:C001:0004]
- **Attitude to risk:** moderately adventurous (ATR score 4) [FF:C001:objectives.atr_score][FF:C001:objectives.atr_descriptor]
- **Capacity for loss:** high, based on substantial liquid assets and high disposable income [FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss][FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss_basis]
- **Age:** 43 [FF:C001:client.age]
- **Employment:** employed, salary [FF:C001:client.employment_status][FF:C001:financial_situation.income_source]
- **Annual gross income:** £211,000 [FF:C001:financial_situation.gross_annual_income_gbp]
- **Monthly essential outgoings:** £2,500 [FF:C001:financial_situation.monthly_essential_expenditure_gbp]
- **Monthly discretionary outgoings:** £1,450 [FF:C001:financial_situation.monthly_discretionary_expenditure_gbp]
- **Cash savings:** £15,000 [FF:C001:financial_situation.assets.cash_gbp]
- **Existing investments:** none [FF:C001:financial_situation.assets.investments_gbp]
- **Emergency fund:** 6 months of expenses [FF:C001:financial_situation.emergency_fund_months]
- **Dependants:** none [FF:C001:client.dependants]
- **Tax band:** additional rate [FF:C001:client.tax_band]
- **ISA allowance used:** £0 [FF:C001:financial_situation.isa_allowance_used_gbp]
- **Knowledge & experience:** previously held cash savings, funds and shares; you trade rarely [FF:C001:knowledge_experience.products_held_before][FF:C001:knowledge_experience.trading_frequency]
The Stocks & Shares ISA wrapper allows you to invest the £14,500 tax‑efficiently, with any income and capital gains sheltered from UK tax [FS:ISA:05].
The underlying Aldercroft Balanced Growth Fund aims for capital growth over a 5‑plus‑year period, matching your stated horizon of “around 5 years” [FS:ISA:02].
Its risk indicator of 4 / 7 aligns with your moderately adventurous risk attitude [FS:ISA:03].

The fund’s diversified multi‑asset composition (≈60 % global equities, 40 % bonds) is appropriate for a medium‑term growth goal while still being within your high capacity for loss [FS:ISA:01][FF:C001:financial_situation.capacity_for_loss].
Charges are transparent and low (total illustrative cost 0.85 % p.a.) and there are no entry, exit or performance fees, helping you keep more of the fund’s growth [FS:ISA:04].
The minimum investment of £1,000 is satisfied by your lump‑sum amount [FS:ISA:07].
Daily dealing and a five‑business‑day withdrawal process give you flexibility should you need to access the money before the end of the horizon [FS:ISA:06].
ADVISER FLAG: Conflict between stated investment horizon of 5 years in the fact‑find and “about 10 years” mentioned in the meeting transcript [FF:C001:objectives.horizon_years][TR:C001:0004]
- **Market risk:** the fund’s value can fall below the amount invested, especially in a bad market year [FS:ISA:03]
- **Currency risk:** non‑GBP holdings expose the portfolio to exchange‑rate movements [FS:ISA:03]
- **No capital guarantee:** you may lose part or all of the invested capital [FS:ISA:03]
- **Holding period:** the product is recommended for a minimum of 5 years; exiting earlier may lock in losses [FS:ISA:03]
- **Liquidity limitation:** withdrawals cannot be replaced within the same tax year without using your ISA allowance [FS:ISA:06]
- Platform fee: 0.25 % p.a. [FS:ISA:04]
- Fund ongoing charge (OCF): 0.60 % p.a. [FS:ISA:04]
- No entry, exit or performance fees [FS:ISA:04]
- Illustrative total annual cost: 0.85 % p.a. [FS:ISA:04]

Given the medium‑term horizon and the fact that market conditions and your personal circumstances may change, a periodic review (e.g., annually) is likely to be needed to ensure the investment remains appropriate [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra]

This suitability report is provided to you before any transaction is concluded, in a durable medium, and sets out the advice we are giving, why it is suitable, the risks, costs and the need for future review [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra]
